slides.h1: You Didn't Panic-Sell Because Of The Market
slides.sub: You panic-sold because of the week you were having. That's Moon bias.

slides.body: This is a pattern-recognition tool for behavior, not a promise about money or a stock pick. No placement or dasha guarantees a financial outcome.
Decisions that track your mood, not your plan. Selling on a bad week. Buying on a good one. The portfolio ends up reactive to your emotional state, not to a thesis.

points: Chandra (Moon) governs the mind, not the intellect
A weak or afflicted Moon reacts faster than it evaluates
Waxing vs waning phase can shift risk appetite week to week
It's the fastest-moving graha — it changes sign every ~2.25 days

slides.body: Build the decision BEFORE the mood hits — a written allocation rule, a rebalancing schedule, a cooling-off period before any sell. Remove the live decision from the emotional moment entirely.
The 4th house (mental peace, emotional base) alongside the 2nd/11th tells you whether the mood-swings are chart-supported or just a rough week — not the same diagnosis.
